theme: Asia session candle retest stats — replication of NY/London intraday series for the Asia killzone
sample_size_days: 219-220 (varies slightly by candle due to data alignment)
session_window: 8:00 PM - 10:00 PM ET (Tokyo morning, classic Asia killzone)
forward_windows: +15 min, +30 min, +45 min after subject candle closes

either_side_retest.description: Probability the high OR low of the subject candle gets touched by a later candle's wick.

both_sides_sweep.description: Probability BOTH the high AND the low of the subject get touched (full sweep).

directional_split.description: Hi-any / Lo-any rates — probability the high (or low) gets touched at all.

session_comparison.verdict: Asia retest rates sit BETWEEN NY and London. Lower magnetism than London open, similar to NY 9:30 at +30 min. Sweep rates ~7pp higher than NY 9:30 but ~10pp lower than London 3:45.

key_findings.1: 8:45 PM ET is the strongest single-candle Asia magnet — 89.09% retest by +15 min, 32.73% sweep rate by +45 min. Coincides with Tokyo opening drive.
key_findings.2: 9:15 PM ET hits 99.54% by +45 min — tied with London 3:45 for the highest +45 rate in the entire repo.
key_findings.3: 9:00 PM is the WEAKEST Asia retest at 75.34% by +15 — the only Asia candle below 80%. Possibly captures a directional move that initially holds before reversing.
key_findings.4: Strong HIGH-bias is the most striking pattern: at 8:00 PM, Hi-any +15 is 51.82% vs Lo-any only 34.55% (17pp gap). NQ's bullish drift compounds with the Asia session's tendency to drift up after Tokyo open.
key_findings.5: Sweep rates moderate compared to London (London 3:45 at 32.42% by +30; Asia 8:45 at 23.64% by +30). Asia is less two-sided than London but more so than NY.
key_findings.6: Asia is a third-tier 'magnetic' session: NY 9:30 < Asia 8:45 < London 3:45 on most metrics. London is the strongest, NY the weakest of the three.

sample_size_caveats: 219-220 days. Aggregate stats trustworthy to ±3pp. Sample size matches NY (232) and London (219) series for direct comparison.
